Sterile · Phase-appropriate

Phase Appropriate Support for Different Development Phases

  1. Development Phase

    Preclinical

    • Feasibility and formulation development for sterile products
    • Early sterility risk assessment and process design
    • Small-scale batch production for toxicology studies

  2. First-in-Human

    Phase I

    • Flexible, small-batch aseptic manufacturing
    • Streamlined documentation in compliance with FDA Guidance for Industry - cGMP for Phase 1 Investigational Drugs
    • Rapid turnaround to support clinical timelines
    • Excellent project management for stakeholder alignment and transparent communication
    • Enhanced environmental monitoring and sterility assurance

  3. Development Expansion

    Phase II

    • Process optimization and scale-up
    • Increased batch consistency and process control
    • Phase appropriate method validation and specification establishment
    • Stability data generation to support Phase III scale-up
    • Alignment with more comprehensive 21 CFR cGMP expectation

Sterile Manufacturing Capabilities

SmaBio Labs supports pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device sponsor companies with sterile Clinical Trial Material (CTM) manufacturing from preclinical development through Phase II clinical trials. SmaBio Labs focuses on aseptic processing, contamination control, and regulatory compliance to ensure the highest standards of product sterility and patient safety.

01

Aseptic Processing

  • Small-scale sterile batch manufacturing
  • Manual and semi-automated filling operations
02

Sterile Dosage Forms

  • Injectable solutions, suspensions and emulsions
  • Ophthalmic solutions and ointments
  • Sterile devices
03

Process Development

  • Process development and optimization for safety, stability and sterility
  • Filter compatibility and integrity testing
  • Support for clinical packaging and labeling
04

Controlled Environment and Infrastructure

ISO 7/8 · ISO 5

  • ISO 7/8 Cleanrooms
  • ISO 5 Biosafety Cabinets
  • Fume Hoods and Laminar Flow Hoods
  • Isolators for High Potent API (HPAPI) handling
  • Segregated manufacturing rooms
  • Monitored warehouse

Non-sterile · Phase-appropriate

CTM Manufacturing for Non-sterile Products

Flexible and scalable solutions for a wide range of dosage forms, ensuring quality, consistency, and regulatory compliance.

  1. Phase 01

    Preclinical

    • Small-scale batch production for toxicology and feasibility studies
    • Fit-for-purpose analytical methods
    • Initial stability assessment

  2. Phase 02

    Phase I

    • Rapid, flexible manufacturing of CTM
    • Phase appropriate documentation (FDA cGMP for Phase 1)
    • Dose escalation and protocol changes
    • Packaging and labeling for clinical use

  3. Phase 03

    Phase II

    • Process refinement
    • Pilot scale-up batches
    • Enhanced analytical testing and method qualification
    • Increased compliance with 21 CFR cGMP requirements
04

Non-Sterile capabilities

  • Liquid Dosage Forms (Solutions, suspension, emulsions)
  • Semi-Solid Dosage Forms (Creams, gels and ointments)
  • ISO 7/8 Cleanrooms
  • Fume Hoods and Laminar Flow Hoods
  • HPAPI isolators
  • Segregated manufacturing rooms
  • Monitored warehouse
